images.caption: River Eden at Cupar. Cupar itself is a charming market town with a rich history and a welcoming atmosphere. Once the county town of Fife, it boasts a mix of historical architecture, independent shops, and cafes. Landmarks such as Cupar Old Parish Church and the Mercat Cross highlight the town’s past, while the nearby Hill of Tarvit mansion and gardens offer further opportunities to explore the area’s heritage. Cupar’s central location makes it an ideal base for discovering Fife, with excellent transport links to nearby towns and attractions.

description: This walk takes you along the River Eden in Cupar, Fife. You can start the walk from Haugh Park next to Victoria Bridge. Haugh Park is a delightful green space in the heart of Cupar, featuring open grassy areas, mature trees, and seasonal flower displays. It’s a popular spot for picnics and offers a peaceful setting to enjoy the outdoors. The River Eden flows gently along the park’s edge, providing a tranquil atmosphere and a chance to spot waterfowl such as mallards, herons, and occasionally kingfishers darting along the riverbanks. The park is also home to some interesting tree species, with oaks, beeches, and chestnuts providing shade and colour throughout the year. The trail then heads east through the park and along the riverside path towards the Eden Valley Business Park. This section of the walk takes you past quiet meadows and areas of wetland vegetation that attract a variety of wildlife. You may encounter rabbits, squirrels, and even deer in the more secluded stretches of the path. In spring and summer, the riverside bursts into life with wildflowers such as cow parsley and buttercups, which add to the vibrant scenery. The path also provides lovely views of the River Eden as it meanders through the countryside, with its calm waters reflecting the surrounding trees and sky.

details.subtitle: Further Information and Other Local Ideas
details.content: Head west and you can continue your walking at the wildlife rich Birnie Loch. Lindores Loch and the climb to Dunbog Hill can also be found in this area.
